jdubois-boot-ui-bootui.description: Install, configure, and use BootUI in Spring Boot and Quarkus applications; assess a running application, propose a prioritized action plan, and execute only approved fixes using runtime evidence. Use when asked to add or troubleshoot BootUI, assess application health, or investigate a slow or failing endpoint, exceptions, SQL, Hibernate, beans, mappings, configuration, health, metrics, logs, or traces; to find runtime-only bugs such as N+1 queries, split transactions, or bypassed @Transactional proxies, or check which routes a code change affects and verify what it changed at runtime after…
